title: Shareholder Meeting
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, the Scranton branch prepares for and attends a tense shareholder meeting amid financial troubles. Dwight performs as his alter ego Recyclops, while Michael readies himself to present as the most successful branch manager. At the meeting, shareholders express anger and dissatisfaction, demanding a plan to save the company. Michael promises a 45 day/45 point plan and introduces Oscar as the one with the solution, though Oscar struggles to present it clearly. Jim asserts his authority as co-manager amidst rumors, and Dwight offers suggestions to improve the meeting's logistics. The episode ends with uncertainty about the company's future and the effectiveness of the proposed plan.
